product.name: Wishlist
product.description: Saved items for any website: multiple named lists of any kind of item, guest lists behind consent that merge into the account on sign-in, revocable read-only share links, price-drop and back-in-stock signals for opted-in customers, and a drop-in heart button, list page and share view — all data in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Lists
elements.description: Named lists of any kind of item (an external id plus a snapshot of title, image, price and URL): a default list per customer, more named lists up to a limit, items per list up to a limit (evict the oldest or refuse when full), customer lists from the website's own login (SS-Identity) or the merchant's server.

elements.name: Guest lists and merge
elements.description: Visitors who are not signed in keep a list under a signed guest token, stored only where the merchant allows and only with the shopper's consent; on sign-in the guest lists merge into the customer's account (into the default list or as separate lists).

elements.name: Share links
elements.description: Read-only share links with an opaque random token (no personal data in the URL), rotated or revoked by the owner at any time, optional expiry, prices shown or hidden.

elements.name: Price-drop and back-in-stock hook
elements.description: Consumes price.changed@1 and inventory.changed@1 (from Catalog or the merchant's server with an sk_ key) and publishes wishlist.price_dropped@1 / wishlist.back_in_stock@1 for customers who opted in on a list, so Alerts or the merchant's own messaging can tell them. Wishlist itself sends no messages.

elements.name: Widgets
elements.description: Drop-in heart button (aria-pressed toggle), list page and share view, built on the headless core and themed with the website's design tokens; one state call per page load.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Lists, guest lists that merge on sign-in and the drop-in widgets; share links and the price-drop hook as add-ons.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: Everything, with more lists and items per customer.
